name: Reliclear
tagline: Enhance, remove background, crop, adjust, and looks — photo cleanup on Anna.
description:
Reliclear is a photo cleanup App for Anna that helps you turn everyday shots into clean, share-ready images without leaving chat.

Core features:
• Remove background — AI cutouts via rembg on the Agent, with a host image.edit path when the platform photo-edit API is available.
• Enhance — improve clarity, color balance, and mild sharpening; uses local classical polish on the Agent (host image.edit optional).
• Edit — crop, rotate/flip, adjust (brightness/contrast/sat/exposure/sharpness), sharpen, denoise, and restore — App UI, with local_adjust / local_denoise for Agent chat.
• Looks — 12 classical look presets (cinematic, vintage, vivid, B&W, golden hour, and more) in the UI and via local_style.
• Effects — blur, vignette, grain, prism.
• Upload → process → preview → download — pick a photo, run a mode, compare before/after, save a PNG. HEIC/HEIF supported.
• Chat tools — enhance_photo, remove_background, local_adjust, local_style, local_denoise for Agent-driven flows alongside the UI.

Desktop-only for now (CUDA / large models): generative remove-object, Real-ESRGAN upscale, portrait AI, clone stamp, batch folders. Reliclear targets Cloud Agent (Linux) and desktop Agents with bundled multi-platform Executa binaries.
